봄.x: Lots of flowers bloom in spring.
봄.e: The four seasons in order: 봄, 여름, 가을, 겨울.

전.forms: noun + 전에 (두 시 전에) · verb + -기 전에 (자기 전에)
전.x: I read a book before going to bed.
전.e: Goes after the time or noun: 수업 전 = before class.
전.t: With time spans it means 'ago': 삼 년 전에 = three years ago.

위.x: There is a book on the desk.
위.e: Opposite of 아래 and 밑. Heads-up: a different 위 means stomach.
위.t: Korean puts the object first: 책상 위에 = 'desk top-at' → on the desk.

위.ex: 매운 음식을 많이 먹어서 위가 아파요.
위.x: I ate a lot of spicy food, so my stomach hurts.
위.e: Homonym warning: native 위 also means 'top, above.'
위.t: In everyday talk, Koreans usually say 배가 아파요 rather than 위가 아파요.

티셔츠.x: In summer I usually wear T-shirts.
티셔츠.e: From English 'T-shirt', often shortened to 티. 반팔 티 = short-sleeve tee.

나가다.ex: 저는 아침 여덟 시에 집에서 나가요.
나가다.x: I leave the house at eight in the morning.
나가다.t: 나가다 = go out (away from the speaker); 나오다 = come out (toward the speaker).

약속하다.m: to promise; to make plans (to meet)
약속하다.x: I made plans to meet my friend tomorrow.
약속하다.t: Pronounced [약쏘카다]. 약속 is also a social appointment: 오늘 약속이 있어요 'I have plans today.'

떠나다.ex: 우리는 내일 아침 일찍 부산으로 떠나요.
떠나다.x: We're leaving for Busan early tomorrow morning.
떠나다.t: The place you leave takes 을/를 (집을 떠나다); the destination takes (으)로 (부산으로 떠나다).

전자레인지.x: I heated the rice in the microwave for two minutes.
전자레인지.e: 전자 'electronic' + English 'range' (a stove) — a Konglish blend, not 'microwave'.

고치다.m: to fix, to repair; to correct; to cure
고치다.x: My dad fixed the broken chair.
고치다.t: Works for objects, mistakes and illnesses: 의자를 고치다, 틀린 글자를 고치다, 병을 고치다.

복습하다.x: After class, I always review at home.
복습하다.t: Pronounced [복쓰파다]; pairs with 예습하다 'preview before class'.

올리다.m: to raise, to lift, to put up; to post, to upload; to raise (prices)
올리다.ex: 어제 찍은 여행 사진을 인스타그램에 올렸어요.
올리다.x: I posted the travel photos I took yesterday on Instagram.
올리다.e: Causative of 오르다 'to go up': literally 'make it go up'.
올리다.t: Online, 올리다 means to post or upload: 사진을/글을 올리다.

아저씨.ex: 택시 아저씨가 길을 친절하게 알려 주셨어요.
아저씨.x: The taxi driver kindly told me the way.
아저씨.e: Everyday address for a middle-aged man who isn't family.
아저씨.t: Fine for shopkeepers or drivers, but don't call a young man 아저씨 — it makes him feel old.

아가씨.m: young lady, miss; husband's younger sister
아가씨.ex: 저 아가씨가 길을 친절하게 가르쳐 줬어요.
아가씨.x: That young lady kindly showed me the way.
아가씨.e: Also what a wife calls her husband's younger sister.
아가씨.t: Calling a server 아가씨 can sound condescending today; 저기요 'excuse me' is safer.

정확하다.m: to be accurate, to be exact, to be correct
정확하다.ex: 내일 모임의 정확한 시간을 알려 주세요.
정확하다.x: Please tell me the exact time of tomorrow's get-together.

빵집.ex: 우리 동네 빵집은 빵이 아주 맛있어요.
빵집.x: The bakery in my neighborhood has really tasty bread.
빵집.e: 빵 'bread', from Portuguese 'pão' via Japanese, + 집 'shop'.
빵집.t: Pronounced [빵찝] — 집 becomes tense in this compound.

놀이터.x: The kids are having fun playing at the playground.

줄.ex: 그 식당 앞에는 항상 줄이 길어요.
줄.x: There's always a long line in front of that restaurant.
줄.e: One word for anything long and thin: a rope, a string, a line of text, a queue.
줄.t: A long line is 줄이 길다; 첫 줄 = 'the first line'.

번호표.x: When you enter the bank, take a number ticket first.
번호표.t: The verb is 뽑다, 'to pull out': 번호표를 뽑다.

간.x: If you drink a lot of alcohol, your liver gets damaged.
간.e: Homonym warning: 간 also means 'seasoning, saltiness,' as in 간을 보다 'to taste for seasoning.'
간.t: 간이 크다, literally 'to have a big liver,' means to be bold or daring.

간신히.ex: 길이 막혀서 간신히 비행기 시간에 맞췄어요.
간신히.x: The roads were jammed, so I barely made my flight.

드물다.ex: 요즘은 손으로 편지를 쓰는 사람이 드물어요.
드물다.x: These days, people who write letters by hand are rare.

적용하다.m: to apply (a rule, method or knowledge)
적용하다.ex: 배운 내용을 실제 생활에 적용해 보세요.
적용하다.x: Try applying what you learned to real life.
적용하다.t: For applying to a job or school, use 지원하다, not 적용하다.

방송하다.ex: 그 드라마는 매주 금요일 밤에 방송해요.
방송하다.x: That drama airs every Friday night.
방송하다.e: Literally 'to release and send out' signals.

디지털.ex: 요즘은 디지털 카메라보다 휴대폰으로 사진을 더 많이 찍어요.
디지털.x: These days people take more photos with phones than with digital cameras.

상속.ex: 아버지가 돌아가신 후 형제들이 재산을 상속했어요.
상속.x: After their father passed away, the siblings inherited the property.
상속.e: Wealth that continues from one generation to the next.

착잡하다.ex: 고향을 떠나는 날 마음이 정말 착잡했어요.
착잡하다.x: On the day I left my hometown, I had really mixed feelings.
착잡하다.e: Literally 'tangled and mixed' — emotions all jumbled together.

붙임성.m: sociability, knack for getting along with people
붙임성.ex: 동생은 붙임성이 좋아서 친구를 쉽게 사귀어요.
붙임성.x: My younger sibling is very sociable and makes friends easily.
붙임성.e: 붙임 'attaching' (from 붙이다) + 성 'quality' — sticking easily to people.
붙임성.t: Pronounced [부침썽]; the usual pattern is 붙임성이 좋다 or 붙임성이 있다.

어느새.m: before one knows it, without noticing, already
어느새.x: While watching the movie, I fell asleep without realizing it.

부딪히다.m: to bump into, collide with; to run into (a problem)
부딪히다.x: The bicycle collided with a car that suddenly pulled out.
부딪히다.e: Passive-style form of 부딪다 'to strike against'.
부딪히다.t: Pronounced [부디치다]; 부딪치다 stresses active hitting, 부딪히다 being bumped or running into something.

전환점.ex: 그 여행이 제 인생의 전환점이 되었어요.
전환점.x: That trip became a turning point in my life.
전환점.t: Usually with 되다: N이 전환점이 되다 'to become a turning point'.

조회수.ex: 어제 올린 영상 조회수가 벌써 만 회를 넘었어요.
조회수.x: The video I posted yesterday already has over ten thousand views.
조회수.t: Pronounced [조회쑤]. Views are counted with 회: 조회수 100만 회. Used for videos, posts and news articles; 조회수가 오르다/나오다 = to get views.

약소국.m: small and weak nation, minor power
약소국.ex: 그 시대에 많은 약소국이 식민지가 되었습니다.
약소국.x: In that era, many weak nations became colonies.
약소국.e: Literally 'weak, small country' — the mirror image of 강대국.
약소국.t: Pronounced [약쏘국]: ㅅ after ㄱ becomes tense.

발전소.ex: 이 발전소는 도시 전체에 전기를 공급합니다.
발전소.x: This power plant supplies electricity to the entire city.

답습하다.m: to follow (old ways) blindly, to repeat (past practice)
답습하다.ex: 새 정부도 이전 정부의 잘못된 정책을 답습하고 있습니다.
답습하다.x: The new government is also repeating the previous government's flawed policies.
답습하다.e: Literally 'tread the same path' — walking in old footsteps.
답습하다.t: Usually negative, implying no originality. Pronounced [답쓰파다].

불가결하다.x: Water is an indispensable element for life.

모순점.ex: 그의 진술에는 여러 가지 모순점이 있었어요.
모순점.x: There were several contradictions in his statement.
모순점.e: Literally 'spear-and-shield point', from the Chinese tale of a merchant claiming both were unbeatable.

방책.m: plan, measure, means (to deal with something)
방책.ex: 정부는 물가를 안정시킬 방책을 찾고 있습니다.
방책.x: The government is looking for measures to stabilize prices.

토론회.ex: 오늘 저녁에 대통령 후보 토론회가 열립니다.
토론회.x: The presidential candidates' debate will be held this evening.

재판부.m: the court, the bench, the panel of judges hearing a case
재판부.x: The court sentenced the defendant to three years in prison.
재판부.e: 재판 'trial' plus 부 'division' — the judges assigned to a trial.

하소연.m: pouring out one's troubles, appeal for sympathy
하소연.ex: 친구가 밤새 직장 문제로 하소연을 했어요.
하소연.x: My friend poured out her troubles about work all night.
하소연.t: Unlike 불평, 하소연 seeks sympathy; common pattern: X에게 하소연하다.

감소세.ex: 신규 환자 수가 일주일째 감소세를 보이고 있습니다.
감소세.x: The number of new patients has been declining for a week.
감소세.t: -세 describes a trend over time; -폭 describes the size of one change.

저고리.x: The color of the hanbok jacket is really pretty.
저고리.e: Native word for the short jacket worn on top in a hanbok.
저고리.t: A woman's hanbok is 저고리 + 치마 (skirt); a man's is 저고리 + 바지 (trousers).

갱생.ex: 출소자의 갱생을 돕는 프로그램이 늘고 있어요.
갱생.x: Programs that help released prisoners rehabilitate are increasing.
갱생.e: Literally 'living again'; here the character usually read 경 is read 갱.

입각.m: joining the cabinet, appointment as a minister
입각.x: He joined the cabinet in this reshuffle.

실험군.x: The experimental group's results were much better than the control group's.
실험군.t: -군 is a reusable research suffix: 실험군, 대조군, 고위험군 (high-risk group).

은하계.ex: 우리 태양계는 은하계의 가장자리 쪽에 있어요.
은하계.x: Our solar system is toward the edge of the galaxy.
은하계.e: Literally 'silver river system' — Koreans call the Milky Way 은하수, the 'silver river.'
은하계.t: 은하계 often means our own Milky Way; for galaxies in general, 은하 alone is common.

역설법.x: 'A silent clamor' is an expression that uses paradox.
역설법.e: Literally 'reverse-talk method'; -법 = rhetorical device: 과장법, 의인법, 도치법.
역설법.t: Pronounced [역썰뻡]; '소리 없는 아우성' (a silent clamor) is the textbook example.

습작.ex: 그는 대학 시절에 습작으로 시를 많이 썼어요.
습작.x: He wrote a lot of poems as practice pieces in college.

산수화.x: I viewed Joseon-era landscape paintings at the museum.

농락하다.m: to toy with, to manipulate, to make a fool of
농락하다.e: Literally 'basket and rope' — catching and controlling someone like an animal.
농락하다.t: Pronounced [농나카다] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

일거에.m: at one stroke, in one go, all at once
일거에.ex: 그 정책으로 여러 문제를 일거에 해결할 수 있습니다.
일거에.x: That policy can solve several problems at one stroke.
일거에.e: 일거 'one move' + 에: everything in a single stroke.

자살률.ex: 한국의 자살률은 OECD 국가 중에서 높은 편입니다.
자살률.x: Korea's suicide rate is relatively high among OECD countries.
자살률.e: -률/-율 = rate, a very productive suffix: 출산율, 실업률, 합격률.
자살률.t: Write 률 after consonants but 율 after vowels or ㄴ, as in 비율 and 할인율.

압축하다.m: to compress; to condense, to narrow down
압축하다.x: Please compress the file and send it by email.
압축하다.t: Figurative too: 후보를 세 명으로 압축하다 (narrow the candidates to three).

들추다.m: to lift and look under; to dig up, rake up (the past, faults); to leaf through
들추다.ex: 이미 끝난 지난 일을 자꾸 들추지 마세요.
들추다.x: Please stop dragging up things from the past that are already over.
들추다.e: Probably related to 들다 'to lift' — you lift something to see what's underneath.
들추다.t: Most common figuratively: 약점을 들추다, 과거를 들추다 — to dig up someone's weak points or past.

움트다.forms: 움터요 · 움텄어요 · 움틀 거예요 · 움튼 (+noun) (ㅡ drops)
움트다.m: to sprout, to bud; (feelings) to begin to grow
움트다.x: When spring came, new shoots sprouted on every branch.
움트다.e: 움 (a fresh sprout) + 트다 (to break open): a sprout breaking through.
움트다.t: Figurative: 사랑이 움트다, 희망이 움트다 — love or hope beginning to bud.

부산물.ex: 이 기술은 우주 개발 과정에서 나온 부산물입니다.
부산물.x: This technology is a by-product of space development.

중과부적.m: being outnumbered, the few can't beat the many
중과부적.ex: 우리는 끝까지 싸웠지만 중과부적이라 결국 졌어요.
중과부적.x: We fought to the end, but we were outnumbered and lost.
중과부적.e: Literally 'the few cannot match the many.'
